title: Former OpenAI Engineer Pleads Not Guilty in Recording Device Case
excerpt: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a former OpenAI engineer, pleaded not guilty to charges of planting a covert audio recording device in a company meeting room.
body_html:
A former OpenAI engineer has entered a not guilty plea regarding charges that he planted a covert audio recording device inside a company meeting room. Abdulrahman Alfozan appeared in a San Francisco federal court on Friday to enter the plea.

Alfozan was arrested and charged last month following the discovery of the recording device at the company's office. Following his recent court appearance, his next scheduled hearing is set for November 17, 2026.
